Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: a processor determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; a processor accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; a processor receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; a processor accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and a processor making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: a processor determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; a processor accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; a processor determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; a processor comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; a processor making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and a processor requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval.
